sentences.zh: 開運元年秋七月辛未朔，帝御崇元殿，大赦天下，改天福九年為開運元年。

translations.literal: On the first day xinwei of the seventh month in autumn of Kaiyun 1, the emperor presided at Chongyuan Hall, proclaimed a great amnesty for all under Heaven, and changed Tianfu 9 to Kaiyun 1.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month in autumn of the first year of Kaiyun, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall, proclaimed a general amnesty, and renamed the ninth year of Tianfu as the first year of Kaiyun.

sentences.zh: 河北諸州，曾經契丹蹂踐處，與免今年秋稅。

translations.literal: All prefectures in Hebei where the Khitan had trampled and ravaged were granted exemption from this year's autumn tax.
translations.idiomatic: Every prefecture in Hebei that had suffered Khitan raids was exempted from the autumn tax for that year.

sentences.zh: 諸軍將士等第各賜優給。

translations.literal: All army officers and soldiers were granted preferential provisions according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers of every rank received preferential grants according to their standing.

sentences.zh: 諸州率借錢帛，赦書到日，畫時罷征，出一千貫已上者與免科徭，一萬貫已上者與授本州上佐雲。

translations.literal: For compulsory loans of money and silk levied in all prefectures: on the day the amnesty edict arrived, collection was to cease at once; those who had contributed one thousand guan or more were granted exemption from corvée levies; those who had contributed ten thousand guan or more were appointed to senior assistant posts in their home prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever prefectures had imposed forced loans of money and silk, collection was to stop the moment the amnesty edict arrived; contributors of a thousand guan or more were exempted from corvée duties, and those of ten thousand guan or more were appointed to senior assistant offices in their home prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是日宣赦未畢，會大雷雨，匆遽而罷。

translations.literal: That day, before the amnesty proclamation was finished, a great thunderstorm occurred, and the ceremony was hurriedly halted.
translations.idiomatic: That day, before the amnesty could be fully proclaimed, a violent thunderstorm broke out and the ceremony was cut short in haste.

sentences.zh: 時都下震死者數百人，明德門內震落石龍之首，識者以為石乃國姓，蓋不祥之甚也。

translations.literal: At the time several hundred people in the capital were killed by the tremors; within the Mingde Gate the head of a stone dragon fell from the shock—those who understood such matters said stone was the imperial surname, an exceedingly ill omen.
translations.idiomatic: The tremors killed several hundred people in the capital; at the Mingde Gate the head of a stone dragon fell away, and those versed in such signs said that stone was the dynasty's surname—a portent of the gravest ill fortune.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以定州節度使馬全節為鄴都留守，加兼侍中；

translations.literal: On guiyou, Ma Quanjie, military governor of Dingzhou, was appointed garrison commander of Yedu, with additional concurrent title of Vice Director of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Ma Quanjie, military governor of Dingzhou, was made garrison commander of Yedu and additionally appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 以昭義節度使安審暉為邢州節度使，加檢校太師。

translations.literal: An Shenhui, military governor of Zhaoyi, was made military governor of Xingzhou and promoted to acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: An Shenhui, military governor of Zhaoyi, was transferred to Xingzhou as military governor and given the acting rank of Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，前陜州節度使王周加檢校太尉，改定州節度使；

translations.literal: On yihai, Wang Zhou, former military governor of Shanzhou, was promoted to acting Grand Commandant and transferred to military governor of Dingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Wang Zhou, former military governor of Shanzhou, was promoted to acting Grand Commandant and made military governor of Dingzhou;

sentences.zh: 鄴都留守張從恩改鄆州節度使。

translations.literal: Zhang Cong'en, garrison commander of Yedu, was transferred to military governor of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cong'en, garrison commander of Yedu, was reassigned as military governor of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 禮官奏：「天子三年喪畢，祫享於太廟，高祖聖文章武明德孝皇帝今年八月喪終畢，合以十月行大祫之禮，冬季祠祭，改薦為祫。

translations.literal: The ritual officials submitted: "When the emperor's three-year mourning is complete, he performs di in the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the mourning for the Sagely Emperor Gaozu, the Filial and Martial Emperor of Illustrious Virtue, ends this eighth month, and the great di rite should be performed in the tenth month; winter sacrifices should be changed from jian to di."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials reported: "After the emperor completes three years of mourning, he should perform the di sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple. Mourning for the Sagely Emperor Gaozu, the Filial and Martial Emperor of Illustrious Virtue, ends this eighth month; the great di rite should be held in the tenth month, and the winter seasonal sacrifices should be changed from jian to di."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，虞部員外郎、知制誥陶穀改倉部郎中、知制誥，大理卿吳德謙改秘書監致仕。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Tao Gu, Vice Director of the Waterways Bureau and drafter of edicts, was transferred to Director of the Granaries Bureau with continued drafting duties; Wu Deqian, Director of the Court of Judicial Review, retired as Director of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Tao Gu, Vice Director of the Waterways Bureau and edict drafter, became Director of the Granaries Bureau while retaining his drafting post; Wu Deqian, Director of the Court of Judicial Review, retired with the title Director of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以左龍武統軍李從敏為潞州節度使，天策府都護軍、桂州節度使、知郎州軍事馬希杲加檢校太師。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Li Congmin, Left Dragon Martial Commander, was made military governor of Luzhou; Ma Xigao, Chief Commander of the Heavenly Strategies Office, military governor of Guizhou, in charge of military affairs at Langzhou, was promoted to acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Li Congmin, commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was appointed military governor of Luzhou; Ma Xigao, chief commander of the Heavenly Strategies Office, military governor of Guizhou, and overseer of military affairs at Langzhou, was promoted to acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，降金州為防禦州，降萊州為刺史州。

translations.literal: On renwu, Jinzhou was reduced to a defense command; Laizhou was reduced to a prefectural command.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Jinzhou was downgraded to a defense command and Laizhou to a prefectural command.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎田敏改兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: Tian Min, Vice Director of the Revenue Bureau, was transferred to Vice Director of the Military Bureau;
translations.idiomatic: Tian Min, Vice Director of the Revenue Bureau, became Vice Director of the Military Bureau;

sentences.zh: 刑部侍郎李祥改尚書右丞；

translations.literal: Li Xiang, Vice Director of Punishments, was made Right Vice Director of the State Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiang, Vice Director of Punishments, was appointed Right Vice Director of the State Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 以潁州團練使馮玉為戶部侍郎，充端明殿學士；

translations.literal: Feng Yu, regimental training commissioner of Yingzhou, was appointed Vice Director of the Revenue Bureau and made an academician of the Duanming Hall;
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yu, regimental training commissioner of Yingzhou, was made Vice Director of the Revenue Bureau and appointed academician of the Duanming Hall;

sentences.zh: 中書舍人趙上交改刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Zhao Shangjiao, Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Director of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shangjiao, Secretariat Drafter, was transferred to Vice Director of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以樞密使、中書令桑維翰充宏文館大學士，太子太傅、譙國公劉句為守司空兼門下侍郎平章事、監修國史、判三司，宰臣李崧、和凝進封爵邑。

translations.literal: On jichou, Sang Weihan, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Secretariat, was made Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall; Liu Gou, Grand Tutor of the Heir and Duke of Qiao, was appointed acting Minister of Works with concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, Supervisor of the National History, and Commissioner of the Three Offices; councillors Li Song and He Ning received promotions in rank and fief.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Sang Weihan, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Secretariat, was made Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall; Liu Gou, Grand Tutor of the Heir and Duke of Qiao, was appointed acting Minister of Works with concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, Supervisor of the National History, and Commissioner of the Three Offices; the chief councillors Li Song and He Ning were advanced in rank and fief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，宣徽北院使劉繼勛改宣徽南院使，三司使董遇改宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Liu Jixun, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Directorate, was transferred to the Southern Bureau; Dong Yu, commissioner of the Three Offices, was made commissioner of the Northern Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Liu Jixun moved from the Northern to the Southern Bureau of the Palace Directorate; Dong Yu, commissioner of the Three Offices, took over the Northern Bureau.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以前陜州節度使石赟為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Shi Yun, former military governor of Shanzhou, was appointed military governor of Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Shi Yun, former military governor of Shanzhou, was made military governor of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 同州節度使李承福卒，贈太傅。

translations.literal: Li Chengfu, military governor of Tongzhou, died and was posthumously awarded Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chengfu, military governor of Tongzhou, died and was posthumously honored as Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，命十五將以禦契丹，

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day xinchou of the eighth month, fifteen generals were appointed to defend against the Khitan,
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first day of the eighth month, fifteen generals were appointed to resist the Khitan,

sentences.zh: （《東都事略·範質傳》：晉出帝命十五將出征。

translations.literal: (From the 《Brief Account of the Eastern Capital, Biography of Fan Zhi》: the Deposed Emperor of Jin appointed fifteen generals for the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: (From the 《Brief Account of the Eastern Capital, Biography of Fan Zhi》: the Deposed Emperor of Jin appointed fifteen generals to take the field.

sentences.zh: 是夕，質宿直，出帝命諸學士分草制，質曰：「宮城已閉，慮泄機事。

translations.literal: That evening Fan was on night duty; the Deposed Emperor ordered the various academicians each to draft the edicts, but Fan said, "The palace gates are already closed—lest military plans leak.
translations.idiomatic: That evening Fan was on palace night duty. The Deposed Emperor told the academicians to divide the edicts among themselves, but Fan said, "The palace gates are already shut—we must not let military plans leak out.

sentences.zh: 」遂獨為之。）〉

translations.literal: " So he alone drafted them.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " So he drafted them all himself.)〉

sentences.zh: 北京留守劉知遠充北面行營都統，鎮州節度使杜威充北面行營都招討使，鄆州節度使張從恩充馬步軍都監，西京留守景延廣充馬步軍都排陣使，徐州節度使趙在禮充馬步軍都虞候，晉州節度使安叔千充馬步軍左廂排陣使，前兗州節度使安審信充馬軍右廂排陣使，河中節度使安審琦充馬步軍都指揮使，河陽節度使符彥卿充馬軍左廂都指揮使，滑州節度使皇甫遇充馬步軍右廂都指揮使，右神武統軍張彥澤充馬軍排陣使，滄州節度使王廷胤充馬軍左廂都指揮使，陜州節度使宋彥筠充步軍右廂都指揮使，前金州節度使田武充步軍左廂排陣使，左神武統軍潘環充步軍右廂排陣使。

translations.literal: Liu Zhiyuan, garrison commander of the Northern Capital, was made overall commander of the Northern Campaign Headquarters; Du Wei, military governor of Zhenzhou, was made chief commander for suppression; Zhang Cong'en, military governor of Yanzhou, was made overall inspector of horse and foot armies; Jing Yanguang, garrison commander of the Western Capital, was made chief array marshal of horse and foot armies; Zhao Zaili, military governor of Xuzhou, was made chief adjutant of horse and foot armies; An Shuqian, military governor of Jinzhou, was made left-wing array marshal of horse and foot armies; An Shenxin, former military governor of Yanzhou, was made right-wing cavalry array marshal; An Shenqi, military governor of Hezhong, was made overall commander of horse and foot armies; Fu Yanqing, military governor of Heyang, was made left-wing cavalry commander; Huangfu Yu, military governor of Huazhou, was made right-wing commander of horse and foot armies; Zhang Yanzhe, Right Divine Martial Commander, was made cavalry array marshal; Wang Tingyin, military governor of Cangzhou, was made left-wing cavalry commander; Song Yanyun, military governor of Shanzhou, was made right-wing infantry commander; Tian Wu, former military governor of Jinzhou, was made left-wing infantry array marshal; Pan Huan, Left Divine Martial Commander, was made right-wing infantry array marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhiyuan, garrison commander of the Northern Capital, became overall commander of the Northern Campaign Headquarters; Du Wei of Zhenzhou became chief suppression commander; Zhang Cong'en of Yanzhou became overall inspector of the combined armies; Jing Yanguang of the Western Capital became chief array marshal; Zhao Zaili of Xuzhou became chief adjutant; An Shuqian of Jinzhou became left-wing array marshal; the former Yanzhou governor An Shenxin became right-wing cavalry array marshal; An Shenqi of Hezhong became overall commander of horse and foot; Fu Yanqing of Heyang became left-wing cavalry commander; Huangfu Yu of Huazhou became right-wing commander; Zhang Yanzhe, Right Divine Martial Commander, became cavalry array marshal; Wang Tingyin of Cangzhou became left-wing cavalry commander; Song Yanyun of Shanzhou became right-wing infantry commander; the former Jinzhou governor Tian Wu became left-wing infantry array marshal; and Pan Huan, Left Divine Martial Commander, became right-wing infantry array marshal.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，閩王王延羲為其下連重遇、朱文進所害，眾推文進知留後事，稱天福年號，間道以聞。

translations.literal: On renyin, the King of Min Wang Yanxi was killed by his subordinates Lian Chongyu and Zhu Wenjin; the masses supported Wenjin to manage garrison affairs, used the Tianfu reign title, and reported through a secret route.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the King of Min, Wang Yanxi, was murdered by his officers Lian Chongyu and Zhu Wenjin; the troops acclaimed Wenjin to handle garrison affairs, adopted the Tianfu reign title, and sent word through a clandestine courier route.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太子少傅盧文紀改太子太傅，太子少保李麟改太子太保，刑部尚書李懌改戶部尚書，給事中司徒詡改右散騎常侍，以府州刺史折從阮為安北都護，充振武節度使。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Lu Wenji, Junior Tutor of the Heir, was made Grand Tutor of the Heir; Li Lin, Junior Guardian of the Heir, was made Grand Guardian; Li Yin, Director of Punishments, was made Director of Revenue; Situ Xu, Supervising Secretary, was made Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry; Zhe Congruan, prefect of Fuzhou, was made Protector-General of the Pacified North and military governor of Zhenwu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Lu Wenji advanced from Junior to Grand Tutor of the Heir; Li Lin from Junior to Grand Guardian; Li Yin moved from Director of Punishments to Director of Revenue; Situ Xu became Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry; and Zhe Congruan, prefect of Fuzhou, was appointed Protector-General of the Pacified North and military governor of Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 是夜，熒惑入南斗。

translations.literal: That night Mars entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: That night Mars entered the constellation of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔復置明經、童子二科。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict restored the Mingjing and Tongzi examination categories.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict reinstated the Mingjing and Tongzi civil-service examinations.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以鄧州節度使王令溫為延州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Wang Lingwen, military governor of Dengzhou, was appointed military governor of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wang Lingwen, military governor of Dengzhou, was transferred to Yanzhou as military governor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以威武軍兵馬留後、權知閩國事朱文進為檢校太傅、福州威武軍節度使，知閩國事。

translations.literal: On guichou, Zhu Wenjin, acting commander of Weiwu Army forces and provisional overseer of Min affairs, was promoted to acting Grand Tutor, military governor of Weiwu Army at Fuzhou, and overseer of Min affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zhu Wenjin, acting commander of the Weiwu Army and provisional overseer of Min, was promoted to acting Grand Tutor, made military governor of the Weiwu Army at Fuzhou, and confirmed as overseer of Min affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，升澶州為節鎮，以鎮寧為軍額，割濮州為屬郡。

translations.literal: On guihai, Cangzhou was elevated to a military commission; Zhenning was made the army designation; Puzhou was detached as a subordinate prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Cangzhou was raised to a full military commission under the designation Zhenning, with Puzhou carved out as its subordinate prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以延州節度使史威為澶州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Shi Wei, military governor of Yanzhou, was appointed military governor of Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Shi Wei, military governor of Yanzhou, was made military governor of Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day gengwu of the ninth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以戶部侍郎韋勛為太子賓客，以前棣州刺史段希堯為戶部侍郎，以光祿卿張仁願為大理卿。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Wei Xun, Vice Director of Revenue, was made Mentor of the Heir; Duan Xiyao, former prefect of Di, was appointed Vice Director of Revenue; Zhang Renyuan, Director of the Imperial Household, was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Wei Xun, Vice Director of Revenue, became Mentor of the Heir; the former Di prefect Duan Xiyao was made Vice Director of Revenue; and Zhang Renyuan, Director of the Imperial Household, was appointed Director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禮部侍郎符蒙卒。

translations.literal: On jichou, Fu Meng, Vice Director of Rites, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Fu Meng, Vice Director of Rites, died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太原奏，代州刺史白文珂破契丹於七里烽，斬首千餘級，生擒將校七十餘人。

translations.literal: On renchen, Taiyuan reported that Bai Wenke, prefect of Daizhou, defeated the Khitan at Qili Beacon, beheaded more than a thousand, and captured alive more than seventy officers.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Taiyuan reported that Bai Wenke, prefect of Daizhou, had routed the Khitan at Qili Beacon, taking more than a thousand heads and seventy-odd officers alive.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以前隴州防禦使翟光鄴為宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On guisi, Zhai Guangye, former defense commissioner of Longzhou, was appointed commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zhai Guangye, former defense commissioner of Longzhou, was made commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Directorate.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以滄州節度使王廷胤卒輟朝，贈中書令。

translations.literal: On jihai, because Wang Tingyin, military governor of Cangzhou, had died, court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously awarded Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, court was suspended upon the death of Wang Tingyin, military governor of Cangzhou, who was posthumously honored as Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，兩浙節度使、吳越國王錢宏佐加守太尉。

translations.literal: In winter, on the tenth month, renyin day, Qian Hongzuo, military governor of the Two Zhes and King of Wuyue, was promoted to acting Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renyin day, Qian Hongzuo, military governor of the Two Zhes and King of Wuyue, was promoted to acting Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以徐州節度使、北面行營馬步都虞候趙在禮為北面行營副都統，鄴都留守馬全節為北面行營副招討使。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Zhao Zaili, military governor of Xuzhou and chief adjutant of the Northern Campaign horse and foot armies, was made deputy overall commander of the Northern Campaign Headquarters; Ma Quanjie, garrison commander of Yedu, was made deputy chief commander for suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhao Zaili of Xuzhou, chief adjutant of the Northern Campaign armies, became deputy overall commander; Ma Quanjie, garrison commander of Yedu, became deputy chief suppression commander.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以起居郎、知制誥賈緯為戶部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Jia Wei, Attendant of the Imperial Diary and drafter of edicts, was appointed Director of the Revenue Bureau with continued drafting duties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Jia Wei, Attendant of the Imperial Diary and edict drafter, became Director of the Revenue Bureau while retaining his drafting duties.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔曰：

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, an edict proclaimed:

sentences.zh: 朕虔承顧命，獲嗣丕基。

translations.literal: I reverently received the dying charge and obtained succession to the great foundation.
translations.idiomatic: I reverently received my predecessor's final charge and succeeded to the great foundation of the state.

sentences.zh: 常懼顛危，不克負荷，宵分日昃，罔敢怠寧，夕惕晨興，每懷祗畏。

translations.literal: I constantly fear collapse and ruin and am unable to bear the burden; from midnight until the sun declines I dare not slacken in repose; vigilant at evening and rising early at dawn, I ever harbor reverent awe.
translations.idiomatic: I live in constant fear that the realm may founder and that I cannot bear its weight; from midnight until the sun sets I dare not rest; evening vigilance and dawn rising are my daily practice, and reverent awe is always in my heart.

sentences.zh: 但以恩信未著，德教未敷，理道不明，咎征斯至。

translations.literal: Yet because kindness and trust have not been made manifest, virtue and instruction have not been spread abroad, the Way of governance is unclear, omens of blame have arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Yet because kindness and trust have not been made plain, virtue and instruction have not reached the people, the principles of governance remain unclear, and signs of blame have appeared.

sentences.zh: 向者，頻年災沴，稼穡不登，道堇相望，上天垂譴，涼德所招。

translations.literal: Recently, for successive years disasters and pestilence have occurred, crops have not ripened, corpses of the starved line the roads, Heaven has sent down reproof—all summoned by my meager virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years disasters and pestilence have come in succession, harvests have failed, and the roads are lined with those who starved—Heaven's reproof, all drawn down by my own deficient virtue.

sentences.zh: 仍屬干戈尚興，邊陲多事。

translations.literal: Moreover, arms are still raised and the borderlands are beset with troubles.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, war still rages and the frontiers are in constant turmoil.

sentences.zh: 倉廩不足，則輟人之糇食；

translations.literal: When granaries are insufficient, we cease the people's dry provisions;
translations.idiomatic: When the granaries run short, we cut off the people's grain;

sentences.zh: 帑藏不足，則率人之資財；

translations.literal: when the treasury is insufficient, we levy the people's wealth;
translations.idiomatic: when the treasury is empty, we levy the people's wealth;

sentences.zh: 兵士不足，則取人之丁中；

translations.literal: when soldiers are insufficient, we take men from the adult male registers;
translations.idiomatic: when troops are lacking, we draft men from the adult registers;

sentences.zh: 戰騎不足，則假人之乘馬。

translations.literal: when war horses are insufficient, we borrow the people's riding horses.
translations.idiomatic: when war horses fall short, we press the people's mounts into service.

sentences.zh: 雖事不獲已，而理將若何！

translations.literal: Although these matters could not be avoided, what shall become of principle!
translations.idiomatic: Though these measures could not be avoided, what has become of right principle!

sentences.zh: 訪聞差去使臣，殊乖體認，不有敦於勉諭，而乃臨以威刑，自有所聞，益深愧悼。

translations.literal: I have learned that the dispatched envoys have greatly departed from proper understanding: instead of earnestly exhorting and instructing, they have confronted the people with harsh punishments; since I heard of this, my shame and grief have deepened.
translations.idiomatic: I have learned that the envoys we sent out have grossly misunderstood their charge: rather than earnestly encouraging and instructing the people, they have confronted them with harsh punishments. Since this came to my ears, my shame and grief have only deepened.

sentences.zh: 旋屬守臣叛命，敵騎入邊，致使甲兵不暇休息，軍旅有征戰之苦，人民有飛免之勞，疲瘵未蘇，科徭尚急，言念於茲，寢食何安！

translations.literal: Soon afterward border commanders rebelled and enemy cavalry entered the frontier, so that armor and weapons had no time to rest; the armies suffered the hardships of campaigning, the people the toil of fleeing like startled hares; the exhausted and sick had not yet recovered, yet corvée levies remained urgent—when I speak of this, how can I find peace in sleep or food!
translations.idiomatic: Soon border commanders turned rebel and enemy horsemen crossed the frontier, leaving our troops no respite; the armies bore the hardships of campaign, the people the labor of frantic flight. The sick and exhausted had scarcely recovered, yet corvée demands remained pressing—at the thought of this, how can I eat or sleep in peace!

sentences.zh: 得不省過興懷，側身罪已，載深減損，思召和平？

translations.literal: Must I not reflect on my faults and rouse my feelings, turn inward and blame myself, deeply reduce expenditures, and seek to summon peace?
translations.idiomatic: Should I not examine my faults, turn inward in self-reproach, cut expenditures to the bone, and strive to restore peace?

sentences.zh: 所宜去無用之資，罷不急之務，棄華取實，惜費省功，一則符先帝慈儉之規，一則慕前王樸素之德。

translations.literal: What is fitting is to remove useless expenditures, abolish non-urgent tasks, abandon ornament for substance, cherish economy and reduce labor—on one hand conforming to the late emperor's rule of kindness and frugality, on the other emulating former kings' plain and simple virtue.
translations.idiomatic: We should strip away useless spending, suspend nonessential projects, choose substance over ornament, and husband resources while reducing labor—both to honor the late emperor's rule of kindness and frugality and to emulate the plain virtue of kings of old.

sentences.zh: 向者，造作軍器，破用稍多，但取堅剛，不須華楚；

translations.literal: Recently, in manufacturing military equipment, expenditures have been somewhat heavy; what is needed is sturdiness and strength, not ornament and display;
translations.idiomatic: Recently the manufacture of military equipment has cost too much; what is required is strength and durability, not ornament and display;

sentences.zh: 今後作坊制器械，不得更用金銀裝飾。

translations.literal: henceforth workshops making weapons and gear must not again use gold and silver decoration.
translations.idiomatic: from now on workshops producing arms and gear must not use gold or silver decoration.

sentences.zh: 比於遊畋，素非所好，凡諸服禦，尤欲去奢，應天下府州不得以珍寶玩好及鷹犬為貢。

translations.literal: Compared with hunting, I have never favored it; for all apparel and equipage I especially wish to remove extravagance; all prefectures and districts under Heaven must not present precious objects, curios, hawks, or hounds as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Hunting has never been to my taste; for all court dress and equipage I especially wish to cut extravagance; no prefecture or district in the realm may present precious objects, curios, hawks, or hounds as tribute.

sentences.zh: 在昔聖帝明君，無非惡衣菲食，況於薄德，所合恭行，今後大官尚膳，減去多品，衣服帷帳，務去華飾，在禦寒溫而已。

translations.literal: In former times sage emperors and enlightened rulers all wore poor clothes and ate plain food; how much more should one of meager virtue respectfully practice this—henceforth the Imperial Kitchen shall reduce its many dishes; clothing and curtains must remove ornament and serve only to guard against cold and heat.
translations.idiomatic: Sage emperors and enlightened rulers of old all wore coarse clothes and ate plain food; how much more should one of my slight virtue do the same. Henceforth the Imperial Kitchen shall cut back its many dishes; clothing and hangings must shed ornament and serve only to keep off cold and heat.

sentences.zh: 峻宇雕墻，昔人所誡，玉杯象箸，前代攸非，今後凡有營繕之處，丹堊雕鏤，不得過度，宮闈之內，有非理費用，一切禁止。

translations.literal: Lofty halls and carved walls were warned against by men of old; jade cups and ivory chopsticks were condemned by former ages—henceforth wherever construction is undertaken, cinnabar plaster and carved tracery must not be excessive; within the palace any unreasonable expenditure is altogether forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty halls and carved walls were condemned by the ancients, jade cups and ivory chopsticks by former ages. Henceforth all construction must limit cinnabar plaster and carved ornament; within the palace any unreasonable expense is forbidden altogether.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 繼聖承祧，握樞臨極，昧於至道，若履春冰。

translations.literal: Inheriting the sage line and receiving the ancestral temple, holding the pivot and reaching the utmost, ignorant of the supreme Way, as if treading spring ice.
translations.idiomatic: Having inherited the sacred line and received the ancestral temple, I hold the reins at the summit of power yet am ignorant of the supreme Way, as though walking on spring ice.

sentences.zh: 屬以天災流行，國步多梗，因時致懼，引咎推誠，期於將來，庶幾有補。

translations.literal: Just now heavenly disasters are widespread and the state's course is full of obstacles; in accord with the times I feel fear, take blame upon myself and extend sincerity, hoping that in the future there may perhaps be some remedy.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's disasters are abroad and the state's path is beset with obstacles; in this season of peril I feel fear, take blame upon myself, and offer sincerity, hoping that the future may yet see some remedy.

sentences.zh: 更賴王公、將相，貴戚、豪宗，各啟乃心，率由茲道，共臻富庶，以致康寧。

translations.literal: I further rely on princes and dukes, generals and ministers, noble kin and powerful clans, each to open your hearts, follow this Way, together attain wealth and plenty, and bring about peace and security.
translations.idiomatic: I further look to princes and dukes, generals and ministers, noble kin and great clans to open your hearts, follow this path together, bring the realm to prosperity, and secure peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 凡百臣僚，宜體朕意。

translations.literal: All officials should embody my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Let every official take my meaning to heart.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，詔曰：「蕃寇未平，邊陲多事，即日雖無侵軼，亦須廣設提防。

translations.literal: On the ninth month, renshen day, an edict stated: "The barbarian enemy is not yet pacified and the borderlands are full of troubles; though at present there is no invasion or raid, defenses must still be broadly set.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the eleventh month, an edict stated: "The barbarian foe is not yet subdued and the frontiers remain troubled; though there is no raid at this moment, defenses must still be widely prepared.

sentences.zh: 朕將親率虎貔，躬擐甲胄，候聞南牧，即便北征，不須先定日辰，別行告諭。

translations.literal: I shall personally lead the tiger guards, don armor myself, and when word comes of their southward pasture I shall at once campaign north—there is no need first to fix a date or issue separate proclamations.
translations.idiomatic: I shall personally lead the tiger guards and don armor myself; when word comes that they are driving south, I shall march north at once—there is no need to fix a date in advance or issue separate notices.

sentences.zh: 所有供億，宜令三司預行計度，合隨從諸司職員，並宜常備行計」云。

translations.literal: All supplies and provisions should be ordered calculated in advance by the Three Offices; all officials of the relevant departments who are to accompany the campaign should likewise keep travel plans in constant readiness." Thus it was stated.
translations.idiomatic: All supplies should be calculated in advance by the Three Offices, and every official of the departments that will accompany the campaign should keep travel arrangements in constant readiness." Thus it ran.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以陳州刺史梁漢璋充侍衛馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On jimao, Liang Hanzhang, prefect of Chenzhou, was appointed overall commander of the Palace Guard cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Liang Hanzhang, prefect of Chenzhou, was made overall commander of the Palace Guard cavalry.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以貝州節度使何建為澶州節度使兼北面行營馬軍右廂排陣使，以澶州節度使史威為貝州節度使。

translations.literal: On renwu, He Jian, military governor of Beizhou, was made military governor of Cangzhou with concurrent post as right-wing cavalry array marshal of the Northern Campaign; Shi Wei, military governor of Cangzhou, was made military governor of Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, He Jian of Beizhou became military governor of Cangzhou and right-wing cavalry array marshal of the Northern Campaign; Shi Wei of Cangzhou was transferred to Beizhou as military governor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以前金州節度使田武為滄州節度使兼北面行營步軍右廂都指揮使，以前相州節度使郭謹為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Tian Wu, former military governor of Jinzhou, was made military governor of Cangzhou with concurrent post as right-wing infantry commander of the Northern Campaign; Guo Jin, former military governor of Xiangzhou, was appointed military governor of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the former Jinzhou governor Tian Wu became military governor of Cangzhou and right-wing infantry commander of the Northern Campaign; the former Xiangzhou governor Guo Jin was made military governor of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥朔，幸臯門，射中白兔。

translations.literal: On the first day jihai of the twelfth month, the emperor visited Gao Gate and shot a white hare.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, the emperor visited Gao Gate and shot a white hare.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，福州節度使朱文進加同平章事，封閩國王。

translations.literal: On guichou, Zhu Wenjin, military governor of Fuzhou, was promoted to Grand Councillor and enfeoffed as King of Min.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zhu Wenjin, military governor of Fuzhou, was made Grand Councillor and enfeoffed as King of Min.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，青州楊光遠降。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Yang Guangyuan of Qingzhou surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Yang Guangyuan of Qingzhou surrendered.

sentences.zh: 光遠子承勛等斬觀察判官邱濤、牙將白延祚、楊贍、杜延壽等首級，送於招討使李守貞，乃縱火大噪，劫其父處於私第，以城納款，遣即墨縣令王德柔貢表待罪。

translations.literal: Guangyuan's sons Chengxun and others beheaded the surveillance commissioner Qiu Tao, the military officers Bai Yanzuo, Yang Zhan, Du Yanshou, and others, and sent their heads to the suppression commander Li Shouzhen; then they set fires and raised a great clamor, seized their father and confined him in a private residence, surrendered the city, and sent Jimo county magistrate Wang Derou to present a memorial awaiting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyuan's sons Chengxun and the others beheaded the surveillance commissioner Qiu Tao and the military officers Bai Yanzuo, Yang Zhan, and Du Yanshou, sending their heads to the suppression commander Li Shouzhen; then they set fires, raised a great uproar, seized their father and held him in a private residence, surrendered the city, and dispatched Jimo magistrate Wang Derou to present a memorial awaiting judgment.

sentences.zh: 楊光遠亦遣節度判官楊麟奉表請死。

translations.literal: Yang Guangyuan also sent his commissioner Yang Lin to present a memorial requesting death.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangyuan also sent his commissioner Yang Lin with a memorial asking to be put to death.

sentences.zh: 詔釋之。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚午，以楊承信為右羽林將軍，承祚為右驍騎衛將軍。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on gengwu day, Yang Chengxin was appointed General of the Right Forest of Feathers Army; Chengzuo was made General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengwu day, Yang Chengxin was appointed General of the Right Forest of Feathers Army and Chengzuo General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard.

sentences.zh: 皆光遠之子，先詣闕請罪，故特授是官。

translations.literal: Both were Guangyuan's sons; because they had first come to court to plead guilty, they were specially granted these offices.
translations.idiomatic: Both were Guangyuan's sons; because they had come to court first to plead guilty, they were specially granted these posts.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，李守貞奏，楊光遠卒。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Li Shouzhen reported that Yang Guangyuan had died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Li Shouzhen reported that Yang Guangyuan had died.

sentences.zh: 初，光遠既上表送降，帝以光遠頃歲太原歸命，欲曲全之，議者曰：「豈有反狀滔天而赦之也！

translations.literal: Initially, after Guangyuan had submitted his memorial of surrender, because Guangyuan had in recent years submitted to the throne from Taiyuan, the emperor wished to spare him completely; but advisers said, "How can there be treason reaching to Heaven and yet pardon him!
translations.idiomatic: At first, after Guangyuan had submitted his surrender memorial, the emperor wished to spare him because he had only recently submitted from Taiyuan; but advisers said, "How can treason of such magnitude be pardoned!

sentences.zh: 」乃命守貞便宜處置。

translations.literal: " So he ordered Shouzhen to deal with the matter as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered Shouzhen to handle the matter as he saw fit.

sentences.zh: 守貞遣人拉殺之，以病卒聞。

translations.literal: Shouzhen sent men to strangle him to death and reported that he had died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhen sent men to strangle him and reported that he had died of illness.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，前登州刺史張萬迪削奪官爵處斬，青州節度判官楊麟配流威州，掌書記任邈配流原州，支使徐晏配流武州。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Zhang Wandi, former prefect of Dengzhou, was stripped of rank and office and executed; Yang Lin, Qingzhou commissioner, was banished to Weizhou; secretary Ren Miao was banished to Yuanzhou; staff officer Xu Yan was banished to Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Zhang Wandi, former prefect of Dengzhou, was stripped of rank and executed; Yang Lin, Qingzhou commissioner, was banished to Weizhou; secretary Ren Miao to Yuanzhou; and staff officer Xu Yan to Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 縱逢恩赦，不在放還之限，並以楊光遠叛故也。

translations.literal: Even if an amnesty should occur, they were not within the scope of release and return—all because of Yang Guangyuan's rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Even if an amnesty were proclaimed, they would not be eligible for release—all on account of Yang Guangyuan's rebellion.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書、權知貢舉竇貞固奏：「試進士諸科舉人入策，舊例夜試，以三條燭盡為限，天成二年改令晝試，今欲依舊夜試。

translations.literal: Dou Zhengu, Director of Works and acting overseer of the tribute examinations, submitted: "For jinshi candidates and examinees of other categories entering the policy examination, the old rule was night examination, limited by the burning of three candles; in Tiancheng 2 it was changed to daytime examination; now we wish to follow the old rule of night examination."
translations.idiomatic: Dou Zhengu, Director of Works and acting overseer of the examinations, reported: "For jinshi candidates and examinees in other categories taking the policy examination, the old practice was a night session limited by three candles; in Tiancheng 2 this was changed to daytime testing; we now ask to restore the night examination."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 曲赦青州管內罪人，立功將士各賜優給，青州吏民為楊光遠詿誤者，一切不問。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to criminals within Qingzhou's jurisdiction; meritorious officers and soldiers were each granted preferential provisions; officials and people of Qingzhou misled by Yang Guangyuan were altogether not questioned.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was proclaimed for criminals in Qingzhou; meritorious troops received preferential grants; and officials and commoners of Qingzhou who had been misled by Yang Guangyuan were not prosecuted at all.

sentences.zh: 青州行營招討使、兗州節度使兼侍衛都虞候李守貞加同平章事，副招討使、河陽節度使符彥卿改許州節度使。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen, suppression commander of the Qingzhou field headquarters, military governor of Yanzhou, and chief adjutant of the Palace Guard, was promoted to Grand Councillor; Fu Yanqing, deputy suppression commander and military governor of Heyang, was transferred to military governor of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen, suppression commander at Qingzhou, military governor of Yanzhou, and chief adjutant of the Palace Guard, was made Grand Councillor; Fu Yanqing, deputy suppression commander and military governor of Heyang, was transferred to Xuzhou as military governor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，降青州為防禦使額，以萊州刺史楊承勛為汝州防禦使。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Qingzhou was reduced to a defense command; Yang Chengxun, prefect of Laizhou, was appointed defense commissioner of Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Qingzhou was downgraded to a defense command, and Yang Chengxun, prefect of Laizhou, was made defense commissioner of Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以工部尚書竇貞固為禮部尚書，太常卿王延為工部尚書，左丞王松為太常卿，以前尚書右丞龍敏為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: On jichou, Dou Zhengu, Director of Works, was made Director of Rites; Wang Yan, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Director of Works; Wang Song, Left Vice Director, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Long Min, former Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Dou Zhengu moved from Director of Works to Director of Rites; Wang Yan from Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to Director of Works; Wang Song from Left Vice Director to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; and the former Right Vice Director Long Min became Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以前安州防禦使李建崇為河陽兵馬留後，以宣徽使翟光鄴為青州防禦使，以內客省使李彥韜為宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On guisi, Li Jianchong, former defense commissioner of Anzhou, was made acting commander of Heyang forces; Zhai Guangye, commissioner of the Palace Directorate, was appointed defense commissioner of Qingzhou; Li Yantao, commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau, was made commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Li Jianchong, former defense commissioner of Anzhou, became acting commander of Heyang forces; Zhai Guangye, Palace Directorate commissioner, was made defense commissioner of Qingzhou; and Li Yantao, commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau, took the Northern Bureau of the Palace Directorate.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以給事中邊光範為左散騎常侍，以樞密直學士、吏部郎中李穀為給事中，依前充職。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Bian Guangfan, Supervising Secretary, was made Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry; Li Gu, Academician Direct of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Personnel Bureau, was made Supervising Secretary, continuing his former duties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Bian Guangfan, Supervising Secretary, became Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry; Li Gu, Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Personnel Bureau, was made Supervising Secretary while retaining his former duties.

sentences.zh: 是月，契丹耶律德光與趙延壽領全軍入寇，圍恒州，分兵陷鼓城、槁城、元氏、高邑、昭慶、寧晉、蒲澤、欒城、柏鄉等縣，前鋒至邢州，河北諸州告急。

translations.literal: That month, the Khitan Yelü Deguang and Zhao Yanshou led the full army in invasion, besieged Hengzhou, sent detachments to capture Gucheng, Gaocheng, Yuanshi, Gaoyi, Zhaoqing, Ningjin, Puzhe, Luancheng, Baixiang, and other counties; the vanguard reached Xingzhou, and all prefectures in Hebei reported urgent distress.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Khitan ruler Yelü Deguang and Zhao Yanshou led the full army in invasion, besieged Hengzhou, and sent detachments to seize Gucheng, Gaocheng, Yuanshi, Gaoyi, Zhaoqing, Ningjin, Puzhe, Luancheng, Baixiang, and other counties; the vanguard reached Xingzhou, and every prefecture in Hebei sent urgent alarms.

sentences.zh: 詔張從恩、馬全節、安審琦率師屯邢州，趙在禮屯鄴都。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zhang Cong'en, Ma Quanjie, and An Shenqi to lead armies and encamp at Xingzhou; Zhao Zaili encamped at Yedu.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Zhang Cong'en, Ma Quanjie, and An Shenqi to take their armies to Xingzhou, while Zhao Zaili held Yedu.

sentences.zh: 開運二年春正月戊戌朔，帝不受朝賀，不豫故也。

translations.literal: On the first day wuxu of the first month in spring of Kaiyun 2, the emperor did not receive court congratulations, because he was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month in spring of the second year of Kaiyun, the emperor declined the New Year court audience on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 己亥，張從恩部領兵士自邢州退至相州，人情震恐。

translations.literal: On jihai, Zhang Cong'en led his troops in retreat from Xingzhou to Xiangzhou, and public sentiment was shaken with fear.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Zhang Cong'en withdrew his troops from Xingzhou to Xiangzhou, spreading panic among the people.

sentences.zh: 趙在禮還屯澶州，馬全節歸鄴都，遣右神武統軍張彥澤屯黎陽，詔西京留守景延廣將兵守胡梁渡。

translations.literal: Zhao Zaili returned to encamp at Chazhou; Ma Quanjie returned to Yedu; Zhang Yanze, commanding general of the Right Divine Guard, was sent to encamp at Liyang; an edict ordered Jing Yanguang, garrison commander of the Western Capital, to lead troops to guard Huliang Ford.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zaili pulled back to Chazhou, Ma Quanjie to Yedu; Zhang Yanze of the Right Divine Guard was posted at Liyang; and Jing Yanguang, garrison commander of Luoyang, was ordered to hold Huliang Ford.

sentences.zh: 契丹寇邢州。

translations.literal: The Khitan raided Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan forces attacked Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 侍衛馬軍都指揮使梁漢璋改鄭州防禦使，典軍如故。

translations.literal: Liang Hanzhang, commanding general of the Palace Guard Cavalry, was transferred to defense commissioner of Zhengzhou, continuing to command troops as before.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Hanzhang, commanding general of the Palace Guard cavalry, was made defense commissioner of Zhengzhou while retaining command of his troops.

sentences.zh: 以齊州防禦使劉在明為相州留後。

translations.literal: Liu Zaiming, defense commissioner of Qizhou, was made acting commander of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zaiming, defense commissioner of Qizhou, was appointed acting commander of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以客省使孟承誨為內客省使。

translations.literal: On guimao, Meng Chenghui, commissioner of the Guests Bureau, was made commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Meng Chenghui moved from the Guests Bureau to the Inner Guests Bureau.

sentences.zh: 滑州奏，今月二日至四日，相州路烽火不至。

translations.literal: Huazhou reported that from the second to the fourth day of this month, beacon fires on the Xiangzhou route did not arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou reported that from the second through the fourth of the month, no beacon signals came from the Xiangzhou road.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以前汝州防禦使宋光鄴為左驍衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Song Guangye, former defense commissioner of Ruzhou, was made grand general of the Left Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Song Guangye, former defense commissioner of Ruzhou, was appointed grand general of the Left Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 詔青州行營將校，自副兵馬使以上，各賜功臣名號。

translations.literal: An edict granted meritorious service titles to each officer of the Qingzhou field headquarters from deputy troop commander upward.
translations.idiomatic: The court awarded meritorious service titles to every Qingzhou field officer from deputy troop commander up.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，帝復常膳。

translations.literal: On yisi, the emperor resumed his regular meals.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the emperor returned to his normal diet.

sentences.zh: 以左武衛上將軍袁{山義}為客省使，上將軍如故。

translations.literal: Yuan [uncertain character], senior general of the Left Martial Guard, was made commissioner of the Guests Bureau, continuing as senior general.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan [uncertain character], senior general of the Left Martial Guard, became commissioner of the Guests Bureau while retaining his rank.

sentences.zh: 詔滑州節度使皇甫遇率兵赴邢州，馬全節赴相州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Huangfu Yu, military governor of Huazhou, to lead troops to Xingzhou, and Ma Quanjie to Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Yu, military governor of Huazhou, was ordered to Xingzhou with his troops, and Ma Quanjie to Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 契丹寇洺、磁，犯鄴都西北界，所在告急。

translations.literal: The Khitan raided Ming and Ci, violated the northwestern border of Yedu, and everywhere reported urgent distress.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan raiders struck Ming and Ci, crossed into the northwestern border of Yedu, and alarms rang out on every side.

sentences.zh: 壬子，王師與契丹相拒於相州北安陽河上，皇甫遇、慕容彥超率前鋒與敵騎戰於榆林店，遇馬中流矢，僅而獲免。

translations.literal: On renzi, the imperial army and the Khitan faced each other on the Anyang River north of Xiangzhou; Huangfu Yu and Murong Yanchao led the vanguard in battle with enemy cavalry at Yulin Inn; Yu's horse was struck by a flying arrow, and he barely escaped.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the imperial army and the Khitan confronted each other on the Anyang River north of Xiangzhou. Huangfu Yu and Murong Yanchao led the vanguard against enemy cavalry at Yulin Inn; Yu's horse took an arrow and he barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: （《遼史》：皇甫遇與濮州刺史慕容彥超將兵千騎，來覘遼軍。

translations.literal: (From the 《History of Liao》: Huangfu Yu and Murong Yanchao, prefect of Puzhou, led a thousand cavalry to reconnoiter the Liao army.
translations.idiomatic: (From the 《History of Liao》: Huangfu Yu and Murong Yanchao, prefect of Puzhou, led a thousand horsemen to scout the Liao forces.

sentences.zh: 至鄴都，遇遼軍數萬，且戰且卻，至榆林店，遼軍繼至，遇與彥超力戰百餘合，遇馬斃步戰，安審琦引騎兵逾水以救，遼軍乃還。）〉

translations.literal: Reaching Yedu, they encountered tens of thousands of Liao troops, fighting while retreating; at Yulin Inn the Liao army continued to arrive; Yu and Yanchao fought fiercely for more than a hundred rounds; Yu's horse was killed and he fought on foot; An Shenqi led cavalry across the water to rescue them, and the Liao army then withdrew.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Near Yedu they met tens of thousands of Liao troops and fought while falling back. At Yulin Inn more Liao forces arrived; Yu and Yanchao battled fiercely for more than a hundred engagements. When Yu's horse was killed he fought on foot until An Shenqi led cavalry across the river to his aid, whereupon the Liao forces withdrew.)〉

sentences.zh: 是夜，張從恩引軍退保黎陽，唯留五百人守安陽河橋。

translations.literal: That night, Zhang Cong'en led his army in retreat to hold Liyang, leaving only five hundred men to guard the Anyang River bridge.
translations.idiomatic: That night Zhang Cong'en withdrew to Liyang, leaving only five hundred men to hold the Anyang River bridge.

sentences.zh: 既而知州符彥倫與軍校謀曰：「此夜紛紜，人無固誌，五百疲兵，安能守橋！

translations.literal: Then the prefect Fu Yanlun and the military officers plotted, saying, "This night is chaotic, and people have no firm resolve—how can five hundred weary soldiers hold the bridge!
translations.idiomatic: Presently the prefect Fu Yanlun consulted his officers: "Tonight everything is in turmoil and morale is unsettled—how can five hundred exhausted men hold a bridge!

sentences.zh: 」即抽入相州，嬰城為備。

translations.literal: " Immediately they withdrew into Xiangzhou and closed the city to prepare defenses.
translations.idiomatic: " They at once withdrew into Xiangzhou and shut the gates to prepare a defense.

sentences.zh: 至曙，賊軍萬餘騎已陣於安陽河北，彥倫令城上揚旗鼓噪，賊不之測。

translations.literal: At dawn, more than ten thousand cavalry of the bandit army had already drawn up north of the Anyang River; Yanlun ordered banners and drums raised on the walls with shouting, and the bandits could not gauge them.
translations.idiomatic: By dawn more than ten thousand enemy horsemen had formed up north of the Anyang River. Yanlun had banners raised and drums beaten on the walls with loud shouting, and the enemy could not tell what they faced.

sentences.zh: 至辰時，渡河而南，悉陣甲騎於城下，如攻城之狀。

translations.literal: By the hour of chen, they crossed the river southward and lined up armored cavalry below the city as if preparing to storm it.
translations.idiomatic: Around mid-morning they crossed south and arrayed armored cavalry beneath the walls as though ready to assault the city.

sentences.zh: 彥倫曰：「此敵將走矣。

translations.literal: Yanlun said, "These enemies are about to flee.
translations.idiomatic: Yanlun said, "The enemy is about to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 」乃出甲士五百於城北，張弓弩以待之，契丹果引去。

translations.literal: " Then he sent out five hundred armored soldiers north of the city, strung bows and crossbows to await them, and the Khitan indeed withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: " He then sent five hundred armored troops out north of the city with bows and crossbows drawn, and the Khitan duly withdrew.

sentences.zh: 當皇甫遇榆林戰時，至晚敵眾自相驚曰：「晉軍悉至矣。

translations.literal: When Huangfu Yu fought at Yulin, by evening the enemy masses alarmed one another, saying, "The Jin armies have all arrived.
translations.idiomatic: During Huangfu Yu's battle at Yulin, by evening the enemy camp panicked among themselves, crying, "All the Jin armies have come!

sentences.zh: 」戎王在邯鄲聞之，即時北遁，官軍亦南保黎陽。

translations.literal: " The Rong King at Handan heard it and immediately fled north; the imperial army also withdrew south to hold Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: " The Khitan ruler at Handan heard this and at once fled north, while the imperial army also withdrew south to Liyang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以河陽留後李建崇為邢州留後，以鳳州防禦使

translations.literal: On jiayin, Li Jianchong, acting commander of Heyang, was made acting commander of Xingzhou, and the Fengzhou defense commissioner
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Li Jianchong, acting commander of Heyang, was appointed acting commander of Xingzhou, and the Fengzhou defense commissioner

sentences.zh: （案：此下有闕文。）〉

translations.literal: (Note: text is missing here.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Note: text is missing here.)〉

sentences.zh: 為河陽留後。

translations.literal: was made acting commander of Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: was appointed acting commander of Heyang.

sentences.zh: 詔李守貞領兵屯滑州，以宣徽北院使李彥韜權侍衛馬步都虞候。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Shouzhen to lead troops and encamp at Huazhou; Li Yantao, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Directorate, was made acting chief adjutant of the Palace Guard horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen was ordered to Huazhou with his troops, and Li Yantao of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Directorate was made acting chief adjutant of the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 改諸道武定軍為天威軍。

translations.literal: The Wuding Army of all circuits was renamed the Tianwei Army.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuding Army units on every circuit were redesignated the Tianwei Army.

sentences.zh: 己未，以前許州節度使李從溫為北面行營都招撫使，以鄆州節度使張從恩權東京留守。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Li Congwen, former military governor of Xuzhou, was made overall suppression commissioner of the Northern Field Headquarters; Zhang Cong'en, military governor of Yanzhou, was made acting garrison commander of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Li Congwen, former military governor of Xuzhou, became overall suppression commissioner of the northern field army, and Zhang Cong'en, military governor of Yanzhou, acting garrison commander of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，相州奏，契丹抽退，其鄉村避寇百姓，已發遣各歸本家營種。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Xiangzhou reported that the Khitan had withdrawn; the common people of villages who had fled the bandits had been sent off each to return home and resume farming.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Xiangzhou reported that the Khitan had pulled back and that villagers who had fled the raids were being sent home to resume planting.

sentences.zh: 初，帝以不豫初平，未任親禦軍旅，既而張從恩、馬全節相次奏賊軍充斥，恒州杜威告事勢危急，帝曰：「北敵未平，固難安寢，當悉眾一戰，以救朔方生靈。

translations.literal: Initially, because the emperor's illness had just abated, he was not equal to personally commanding the army; then Zhang Cong'en and Ma Quanjie in succession reported that bandit armies filled the land, and Du Wei of Hengzhou reported that the situation was critically urgent; the emperor said, "The northern enemy is not yet pacified—how can I indeed rest easy? We must deploy the full force in one battle to save the people of the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: At first, with his illness only recently recovered, the emperor was not yet fit to take the field in person. Then Zhang Cong'en and Ma Quanjie reported in turn that enemy armies were everywhere, and Du Wei of Hengzhou warned that the situation was desperate. The emperor said, "While the northern foe remains undefeated I cannot rest. We must commit our full strength in one battle to save the people of the north.

sentences.zh: 若宴安遲疑，則大河以北，淪為寇壤矣。

translations.literal: If we feast in peace and delay and hesitate, then north of the Great River will become bandit territory.
translations.idiomatic: If we linger in ease and hesitation, everything north of the Yellow River will fall to the invaders.

sentences.zh: 」即日命諸將點閱，以定行計。

translations.literal: " That same day he ordered the generals to muster and review troops to settle the campaign plan.
translations.idiomatic: " That same day he ordered the generals to review the troops and fix the expedition plan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，下詔親征。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict was issued for the emperor's personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court issued an edict announcing the emperor's personal campaign.

sentences.zh: 誅楊光遠部下指揮使張迥等五人，以戎事方興，慮其扇搖故也。

translations.literal: Zhang Jiong and four other commanders under Yang Guangyuan were executed, because with military affairs increasing they feared these men might incite unrest.
translations.idiomatic: Five commanders under Yang Guangyuan, including Zhang Jiong, were executed, lest they stir up trouble while the war was under way.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以樞密直學士李穀為三司副使，判留司三司公事。

translations.literal: On guihai, Li Gu, Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made deputy commissioner of the Three Departments and put in charge of Three Departments business left behind at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Li Gu, Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made deputy commissioner of the Three Departments and charged with Three Departments affairs at the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，車駕發離京師。

translations.literal: On yichou, the imperial carriage departed the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the emperor left the capital.

sentences.zh: 是月，京城北壕春冰之上有文，若大樹花葉，凡數十株，宛若圖畫，觀者如堵。

translations.literal: That month, on the spring ice of the northern moat of the capital there were patterns like great trees with flowers and leaves—several dozen in all—as if painted pictures; viewers packed like a wall.
translations.idiomatic: That month patterns like flowering trees appeared on the spring ice of the capital's northern moat—several dozen of them, as vivid as paintings—and crowds of onlookers packed the banks.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰朔，車駕次滑州。

translations.literal: On the first day wuchen of the second month, the imperial carriage halted at Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month the emperor stopped at Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，渡浮橋，幸黎陽勞軍，至晚還滑州。

translations.literal: On jisi, he crossed the pontoon bridge, visited Liyang to encourage the troops, and returned to Huazhou in the evening.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he crossed the pontoon bridge, went to Liyang to review the troops, and returned to Huazhou that evening.

sentences.zh: 以滄州節度使田武充東北面行營都部署。

translations.literal: Tian Wu, military governor of Cangzhou, was made overall commander of the Northeastern Field Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Wu, military governor of Cangzhou, was appointed overall commander of the northeastern field army.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸澶州，以景延廣為隨駕馬步軍都鈐轄。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, he visited Chazhou and made Jing Yanguang overall commander of the horse and foot armies accompanying the imperial progress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he went to Chazhou and made Jing Yanguang overall commander of the horse and foot troops accompanying the imperial progress.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大閱諸軍於戚城，帝親臨之。

translations.literal: On bingzi, a grand review of all armies was held at Qicheng, and the emperor attended in person.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi all armies were reviewed at Qicheng under the emperor's personal supervision.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，北面行營副招討使馬全節、行營都監李守貞、右神武統軍張彥澤等以前軍先發。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Ma Quanjie, deputy suppression commissioner of the Northern Field Headquarters, Li Shouzhen, field superintendent, Zhang Yanze, commanding general of the Right Divine Guard, and others led the advance guard to depart first.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Ma Quanjie, deputy suppression commissioner of the northern field army, Li Shouzhen, field superintendent, Zhang Yanze of the Right Divine Guard, and others marched out with the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以許州節度使符彥卿為北面行營馬軍都指揮使，以左神武統軍潘環為北面行營步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On jimao, Fu Yanqing, military governor of Xuzhou, was made commanding general of cavalry of the Northern Field Headquarters; Pan Huan, commanding general of the Left Divine Guard, was made commanding general of infantry of the Northern Field Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Fu Yanqing, military governor of Xuzhou, became commanding general of the northern field cavalry, and Pan Huan of the Left Divine Guard commanding general of the northern field infantry.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸楊村故壘。

translations.literal: On xinsi, he visited the old encampment at Yang Village.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the emperor visited the old camp at Yang Village.

sentences.zh: 符彥卿、皇甫遇、李殷率諸軍進發。

translations.literal: Fu Yanqing, Huangfu Yu, and Li Yin led the armies in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanqing, Huangfu Yu, and Li Yin marched the armies forward.

sentences.zh: 以左散騎常侍邊光範為樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Bian Guangfan, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Guangfan, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was appointed Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔河北諸州，應蕃騎經由之地，吏民遭殺害者，委所在收瘞，量事祭奠。

translations.literal: An edict to all prefectures in Hebei: in places where barbarian cavalry had passed, for officials and commoners who had been killed, the local authorities were to collect and bury the bodies and perform appropriate rites of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered every Hebei prefecture where Khitan cavalry had passed to gather and bury officials and commoners who had been killed and to perform appropriate funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 詔恒州杜威與馬全節等會合進軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Du Wei of Hengzhou to join Ma Quanjie and the others in advancing the army.
translations.idiomatic: Du Wei of Hengzhou was ordered to link up with Ma Quanjie and the others and advance.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，幸鐵丘閱馬，因幸趙在禮、李從溫軍。

translations.literal: On bingxu, he visited Tieqiu to review horses, and then visited the armies of Zhao Zaili and Li Congwen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he reviewed horses at Tieqiu and then inspected the armies of Zhao Zaili and Li Congwen.

sentences.zh: 是日大雪。

translations.literal: That day there was heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: That day brought heavy snow.

sentences.zh: 戊子，安審琦、梁漢璋領兵北征。

translations.literal: On wuzi, An Shenqi and Liang Hanzhang led troops on the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi An Shenqi and Liang Hanzhang marched north with their troops.

sentences.zh: 府州防禦使折從阮奏，部領兵士攻圍契丹勝州，降之，見進兵趨朔州。

translations.literal: Zhe Congruan, defense commissioner of Fuzhou, reported that he had led troops to besiege the Khitan Shengzhou, surrendered it, and now saw the advancing army moving toward Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhe Congruan, defense commissioner of Fuzhou, reported that his troops had besieged and captured the Khitan Shengzhou and were now advancing toward Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以河中節度使安審琦為北面行營馬步軍都虞候，許州節度使符彥卿充馬步軍左廂都指揮使，滑州節度使皇甫遇充馬步軍右廂都指揮使，侍衛馬軍都指揮使梁漢璋充馬軍左右廂都指揮使，侍衛步軍都指揮使李殷充步軍左右廂都指揮使，左神武統軍張彥澤充馬軍左右廂都排陣使，右神武統軍潘環充步軍左右廂排陣使。

translations.literal: On jiawu, An Shenqi, military governor of Hezhong, was made chief adjutant of horse and foot of the Northern Field Headquarters; Fu Yanqing, military governor of Xuzhou, was appointed overall commanding general of the left wing of horse and foot; Huangfu Yu, military governor of Huazhou, was appointed overall commanding general of the right wing of horse and foot; Liang Hanzhang, commanding general of the Palace Guard Cavalry, was appointed overall commanding general of the left and right wings of cavalry; Li Yin, commanding general of the Palace Guard Infantry, was appointed overall commanding general of the left and right wings of infantry; Zhang Yanze, commanding general of the Left Divine Guard, was appointed battle-array commander of the left and right wings of cavalry; Pan Huan, commanding general of the Right Divine Guard, was appointed battle-array commander of the left and right wings of infantry.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu An Shenqi, military governor of Hezhong, became chief adjutant of the northern field horse and foot; Fu Yanqing of Xuzhou overall commander of the left wing; Huangfu Yu of Huazhou overall commander of the right wing; Liang Hanzhang, Palace Guard cavalry commander, overall commander of both cavalry wings; Li Yin, Palace Guard infantry commander, overall commander of both infantry wings; Zhang Yanze of the Left Divine Guard battle-array commander of both cavalry wings; and Pan Huan of the Right Divine Guard battle-array commander of both infantry wings.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以端明殿學士、尚書戶部侍郎馮玉為戶部尚書，充樞密使。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Feng Yu, Hanlin Academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Minister of Revenue and appointed Chief of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Feng Yu, Hanlin Academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of Revenue, became Minister of Revenue and Chief of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，契丹陷祁州，刺史沈斌死之。

translations.literal: In the third month on wuxu, the Khitan captured Qizhou; the prefect Shen Bin died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuxu, the Khitan seized Qizhou; Prefect Shen Bin was killed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，左補闕袁範先陷契丹，自賊中逃歸。

translations.literal: On yisi, Yuan Fan, Left Remonstrator, had first been captured by the Khitan and escaped from the bandits to return.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Yuan Fan, Left Remonstrator, who had earlier fallen to the Khitan, escaped from the enemy and returned.

sentences.zh: 杜威奏，與李守貞、馬全節、安審琦、皇甫遇部領大軍赴定州。

translations.literal: Du Wei reported that he, with Li Shouzhen, Ma Quanjie, An Shenqi, and Huangfu Yu, were leading the great army toward Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Du Wei reported that he was marching a great army toward Dingzhou with Li Shouzhen, Ma Quanjie, An Shenqi, and Huangfu Yu.

sentences.zh: 易州刺史安審約奏，二月三日夜，差壯丁斫敵營，殺敵十餘人。

translations.literal: An Shenyao, prefect of Yizhou, reported that on the night of the third day of the second month he sent stalwart men to cut into the enemy camp and killed more than ten enemies.
translations.idiomatic: An Shenyao, prefect of Yizhou, reported that on the third night of the second month he sent strong men to raid the enemy camp and killed more than ten foes.

sentences.zh: 是日，以符彥卿為北面行營馬步軍左右廂都排陣使，以皇甫遇為北面行營馬步軍左廂排陣使，以王周為馬步軍右廂排陣使。

translations.literal: That day, Fu Yanqing was made battle-array commander of the left and right wings of horse and foot of the Northern Field Headquarters; Huangfu Yu was made battle-array commander of the left wing of horse and foot of the Northern Field Headquarters; Wang Zhou was made battle-array commander of the right wing of horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: That day Fu Yanqing became battle-array commander of both wings of the northern field horse and foot; Huangfu Yu battle-array commander of the left wing; and Wang Zhou battle-array commander of the right wing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，畋於戚城，還幸景延廣、安審信軍。

translations.literal: On dingwei, he hunted at Qicheng, then visited the armies of Jing Yanguang and An Shenxin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he hunted at Qicheng and then inspected the armies of Jing Yanguang and An Shenxin.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，王師攻泰州，刺史晉庭謙以城降。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the imperial army attacked Taizhou; the prefect Jin Tingqian surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the imperial army besieged Taizhou, and Prefect Jin Tingqian surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 易州奏，郎山塞將孫方簡破契丹千餘人，斬蕃將諧裏相公，擄其妻以獻。

translations.literal: Yizhou reported that Sun Fangjian, garrison commander of Langshan Pass, defeated more than a thousand Khitan, beheaded the barbarian general Xieli Xianggong, and captured his wife to present as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou reported that Sun Fangjian, commander at Langshan Pass, routed more than a thousand Khitan, killed the barbarian general Xieli Xianggong, and sent his captured wife as tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，杜威奏，收復滿城，獲契丹首領沒剌相公，並蕃漢兵士二千人。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Du Wei reported the recovery of Mancheng, the capture of the Khitan leader Molie Xianggong, and two thousand barbarian and Han soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Du Wei reported the recapture of Mancheng, the seizure of the Khitan leader Molie Xianggong, and two thousand barbarian and Han troops.

sentences.zh: 以前戶部尚書李懌為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Li Yi, former Minister of Revenue, was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yi, former Minister of Revenue, was appointed Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，杜威奏，收復遂城。

translations.literal: On yimao, Du Wei reported the recovery of Suicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Du Wei reported the recapture of Suicheng.

sentences.zh: 丙辰奏，大軍自遂城卻退至滿城。

translations.literal: On bingchen it was reported that the great army had retreated from Suicheng back to Mancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen came word that the main army had pulled back from Suicheng to Mancheng.

sentences.zh: 時賊將趙延壽部曲來降，言：「契丹主昨至古北口，幽州走報，漢軍大下，收卻泰州。

translations.literal: At that time Zhao Yanshou's bandit general's followers came to surrender, saying, "The Khitan ruler yesterday reached Gubei Pass; from Youzhou urgent reports arrived that Han armies were descending in force and had recovered Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: At that time followers of the renegade general Zhao Yanshou surrendered and reported, "The Khitan ruler reached Gubei Pass yesterday; urgent word from Youzhou said Han armies were descending in force and had retaken Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 尋下令諸部，令輜重入塞，輕騎卻回。

translations.literal: Soon he ordered the various divisions to send baggage trains into the frontier passes and turn the light cavalry back.
translations.idiomatic: He soon ordered his divisions to send baggage into the passes and turn the light cavalry back.

sentences.zh: 戎王率五萬餘騎，來勢極盛，明日前鋒必至，請為之備。

translations.literal: The Rong King leads more than fifty thousand cavalry; his coming force is extremely strong; tomorrow the vanguard will surely arrive—please prepare for it.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler is coming with more than fifty thousand horsemen in overwhelming force; the vanguard will arrive tomorrow—please make ready.

sentences.zh: 」杜威、李守貞謀曰：「我師糧運不繼，深入賊疆，而逢大敵，亡之道也。

translations.literal: " Du Wei and Li Shouzhen plotted, saying, "Our army's grain supplies do not continue; we have penetrated deep into bandit territory and now meet a great enemy—this is the way to destruction.
translations.idiomatic: " Du Wei and Li Shouzhen conferred: "Our supplies cannot keep up; we are deep in enemy country facing a great force—this is the road to ruin.

sentences.zh: 不如退還泰州，觀其兵勢強弱而禦之。

translations.literal: Better to withdraw back to Taizhou, observe the strength or weakness of their military force, and resist accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Better to fall back to Taizhou, gauge their strength, and meet them from there.

sentences.zh: 」軍士皆以為然。

translations.literal: " The soldiers all agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " The troops all agreed.

sentences.zh: 是日，還滿城。

translations.literal: That day, they returned to Mancheng.
translations.idiomatic: That day the army fell back to Mancheng.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，至泰州。

translations.literal: On dingsi, they reached Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi they reached Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，契丹前鋒已至。

translations.literal: On wuwei, the Khitan vanguard had already arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwei the Khitan vanguard was already on the field.

sentences.zh: 己未，大軍發泰州而南，契丹踵其後。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the great army set out south from Taizhou, and the Khitan followed at their heels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the main army marched south from Taizhou with the Khitan close behind.

sentences.zh: 是日，次陽城。

translations.literal: That day, they halted at Yangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: That day they camped at Yangcheng.

sentences.zh: 庚申，敵騎如墻而來，我步軍為方陣以禦之。

translations.literal: On gengshen, enemy cavalry came like a wall; our infantry formed square battle arrays to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen enemy horsemen came on like a wall, and our infantry formed square formations to meet them.

sentences.zh: 選勁騎擊賊，鬥二十餘合，南行十餘里，賊勢稍卻，渡白溝而去。

translations.literal: Selected elite cavalry struck the bandits; after more than twenty rounds of fighting they marched south more than ten li; the bandit force slightly fell back, crossed the White Ditch, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Elite cavalry were chosen to attack the enemy. After more than twenty engagements they marched south some ten li; the enemy pressure eased, and they crossed the White Ditch and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，杜威召諸將議曰：「戎首自來，實為敵，若不血戰，吾輩何以求免。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Du Wei summoned the generals to counsel, saying, "The Rong chieftain has come in person—he is indeed the enemy; if we do not fight a bloody battle, how can we seek to escape?
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Du Wei called the generals together: "The enemy chieftain has come in person; if we do not fight to the blood, how are we to escape?

sentences.zh: 」諸將然之。

translations.literal: " The generals agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " The generals assented.

sentences.zh: 是日，敵騎還繞官軍，相去數里。

translations.literal: That day, enemy cavalry circled back around the imperial army, several li apart.
translations.idiomatic: That day enemy horsemen circled the imperial army, keeping several li away.

sentences.zh: 明日，我軍成列而行，蕃漢轉鬥，殺聲震地，才行十餘里，軍中人馬饑乏。

translations.literal: The next day, our army marched in formation; barbarian and Han forces fought in turn; the cries of killing shook the earth; they had marched only more than ten li when men and horses in the army were hungry and exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: The next day our army marched in column while barbarian and Han forces traded blows; the battle cries shook the ground, yet after only ten li the troops and horses were starving and spent.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，大軍至白團衛村下營。

translations.literal: On guihai, the great army reached Bai Tuanwei Village and made camp.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the main army encamped at Bai Tuanwei Village.

sentences.zh: 人馬俱渴，營中掘井，及水輒壞，兵士取其泥絞汁而飲。

translations.literal: Men and horses alike were thirsty; wells were dug in camp, but whenever water was reached the wells collapsed; soldiers took the mud and squeezed out its juice to drink.
translations.idiomatic: Men and horses were parched; wells dug in camp collapsed as soon as water was struck, and soldiers squeezed juice from the mud to drink.

sentences.zh: 敵眾圍繞，漸束其營。

translations.literal: The enemy masses surrounded them and gradually tightened around the camp.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy masses closed in and steadily tightened the ring around the camp.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·藥元福傳》：晉師列方陣，設拒馬為行寨，契丹以奇兵出陣後，斷糧道。）〉

translations.literal: (From the 《History of Song, Biography of Yao Yuanfu》: the Jin army formed square arrays and set chevaux-de-frise as a traveling encampment; the Khitan sent elite troops out behind the formation and cut the supply route.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (From the 《History of Song, Biography of Yao Yuanfu》: the Jin army drew up in squares with chevaux-de-frise for a marching camp; the Khitan sent elite troops around behind the formation and severed the supply line.)〉

sentences.zh: 是日，東北風猛，揚塵折樹。

translations.literal: That day, a fierce northeast wind raised dust and snapped trees.
translations.idiomatic: That day a fierce northeast wind whipped up dust and snapped trees.

sentences.zh: 契丹主坐車中謂眾曰：「漢軍盡來，只有此耳，今日並可生擒，然後平定天下。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler, seated in his carriage, said to the multitude, "The Han armies have all come—there is only this force; today we can capture them all alive, and afterward pacify all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Seated in his carriage, the Khitan ruler told his followers, "All the Han armies have come, and this is all there is—today we can take them alive and then pacify the realm.

sentences.zh: 」令下馬拔鹿角，飛矢雨集。

translations.literal: " He ordered them to dismount and pull up the chevaux-de-frise; flying arrows fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered his men to dismount and uproot the chevaux-de-frise, and arrows fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 軍士大呼曰：「招討使何不用軍，而令士卒虛死！

translations.literal: The soldiers cried out loudly, "Suppression Commissioner, why do you not commit the army, yet let the soldiers die for nothing!
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers shouted, "Suppression Commissioner, why will you not fight, yet leave the troops to die in vain!

sentences.zh: 」諸將鹹請擊之。

translations.literal: " All the generals earnestly requested that they attack.
translations.idiomatic: The generals all pressed for an attack.

sentences.zh: 杜威曰：「俟風勢稍慢，觀其進退。

translations.literal: Du Wei said, "Wait until the wind slackens somewhat and observe whether they advance or withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Du Wei said, "Let us wait until the wind eases and see whether they advance or pull back.

sentences.zh: 」守貞曰：「此風助我也。

translations.literal: " Shouzhen said, "This wind aids us.
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhen said, "This wind is on our side.

sentences.zh: 彼眾我寡，黑風之內，莫測多少，若候風止，我輩無噍類矣。

translations.literal: They are many and we few; within this black wind none can tell their numbers—if we wait until the wind stops, none of us will be left alive.
translations.idiomatic: They outnumber us, and in this black wind no one can tell how many they are. If we wait for the wind to die, not one of us will survive.

sentences.zh: 」即呼眾軍齊力擊賊。

translations.literal: " He immediately called on the whole army to strike the enemy together with all their strength.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately ordered the whole army to attack the enemy with full force.

sentences.zh: 張彥澤、符彥卿、皇甫遇等率騎奮擊，風勢尤猛，沙塵如夜，敵遂大敗。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanzhe, Fu Yanqing, Huangfu Yu, and others led the cavalry in fierce attack; the wind grew still fiercer, sand and dust were like night, and the enemy was utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanzhe, Fu Yanqing, Huangfu Yu, and others led the cavalry in a furious charge. The wind blew harder still, sand and dust turned day to night, and the enemy was routed.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·符彥卿傳》：時晉師居下風，將戰，弓弩莫施。
